二是强化协同创新，打破校际、校企、学科壁垒，组建跨学科、跨机构、跨区域的创新联合: Second is to strengthen collaborative innovation, breaking down barriers between schools, between schools and enterprises, and between disciplines, organizing cross-disciplinary, cross-institutional, and cross-regional innovation coalitions to jointly overcome major challenges in the artificial intelligence field

高校今天面对的是“如何用好AI”的必答题，必须直面挑战、把握机遇，以未来眼光推进: Universities today face the must-answer question of 'how to use AI well', and must confront challenges and seize opportunities, advancing supply-side reform in talent cultivation with a forward-looking perspective
厦门大学深化推进“三个转变”，即从以教师为中心向以学生为中心转变、以教为中心向以: Xiamen University deepens the implementation of 'three transformations': transforming from teacher-centered to student-centered, from teaching-centered to learning-centered, and from unified model cultivation to personalized needs-based cultivation, actively implementing three 'full openings'—fully opening major changes, course selection, and teacher selection, developing the intelligent study companion 'Xiaodon', constructing a diversified AIGC support foundation, providing faculty and students with 'Xiada Smart Cloud' personal AI suite services, comprehensively building a new smart teaching ecosystem

善用人工智能 赋能语文素养: Make good use of artificial intelligence to empower Chinese language literacy

生成式人工智能各类产品在语文教育学习中的应用，既有经验，也有反思，还需辩证看待: The application of various generative AI products in Chinese language education has both experiences and reflections, and requires a dialectical perspective
AI赋能语文素养，不能满足于将语文知识“技术化”: AI empowering Chinese language literacy cannot be satisfied with reducing Chinese language knowledge to mere 'techniques'
在语文课堂上，教师常常利用AI生成动画效果，形象化地解说某一知识点: In Chinese language classrooms, teachers often use AI to generate animation effects to vividly explain certain knowledge points
也喜欢借助AI让课本中的人物现身说法，与学生进行穿越时空的交流: They also like to use AI to bring characters from textbooks to life, engaging students in conversations across time and space
AI最擅长的技术，未必是语文最需要的素养: What AI is best at technically is not necessarily what Chinese language education most needs in terms of literacy
AI赋能语文素养，也不能迷信AI能力训练的“高效”: AI empowering Chinese language literacy also cannot blindly believe in the 'efficiency' of AI ability training
很多中小学生会借助AI的修改建议，一遍遍打磨自己的作文: Many primary and secondary school students use AI's revision suggestions to polish their compositions repeatedly
自己先写，然后让AI润色，或者AI先写，自己再修改，如此反复几轮，得到AI高分评: Write first and then have AI refine it, or have AI write first and then revise it oneself, repeating this cycle several times—articles that receive high scores from AI indeed rarely have 'fatal flaws,' with appropriate content and proper form, yet always seem to lack individuality and vitality
如果AI的辅助不给主题、题材、视角乃至语言上的多样化留空间，只在一套评测标准下进: If AI assistance does not leave room for diversity in themes, subject matter, perspectives, and even language, but instead conducts closed training in a closed loop within a single evaluation standard, it appears efficient on the surface but is actually full of hack work, which is detrimental to the improvement of Chinese language literacy
之所以提出以上问题，是想强调工具性与人文性的统一，语文教育不能简单地将AI当工具: The reason for raising these issues is to emphasize the unity of instrumentality and humanistic value; Chinese language education cannot simply use AI as a tool, but rather should use the introduction of AI as an opportunity to help schools and society as a whole re-examine the goals and paths for improving Chinese language literacy
什么样的知识可以通过AI方便地获取，什么样的知识必须通过反复的识记和文化的浸润才: What kinds of knowledge can be conveniently obtained through AI, and what kinds of knowledge must be mastered through repeated memorization and cultural immersion
AI时代哪些语文能力过时了，哪些方面有了更高要求，又有哪些新的能力成为必需: In the AI era, which Chinese language abilities have become obsolete, which aspects have higher requirements, and which new abilities have become necessary
目前AI工具尚未成熟，语文教育可以与AI研发相互促进，引导全民特别是青少年辩证认: Currently, AI tools are not yet mature, and Chinese language education can mutually promote and advance AI research and development, guiding the general public, especially young people, to dialectically understand new experiences brought by AI, and while improving the ability to use language and writing, continuously reflect on what makes humans human and what makes culture cultural, gradually forming academic literacy, emotional attitudes, and moral cultivation that adapt to the needs of the times
